recognize_zh: 中央骨髓系前驅細胞的細胞質下半部充滿粗大、紫紅色的巨大顆粒，下方嗜酸性系細胞含極大的橘紅色圓形顆粒，左上角另一顆細胞邊緣也可見巨大顆粒，是 Chediak-Higashi 症候群的典型表現。
features: Promyelocyte/myelocyte with abundant blue cytoplasm filled with coarse, oversized pink-purple granules
Eosinophilic precursors with huge, round orange-red granules, some spilling from a disrupted cell
Additional precursors with few large irregular dark granules
Round to indented nuclei with fine to moderately condensed chromatin
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows granulocytic precursors at several stages. A central promyelocyte/myelocyte contains coarse, abnormally large pink-purple cytoplasmic granules, and eosinophilic precursors contain huge, round orange-red granules, some released from a disrupted cell. Other myeloid cells contain a few large irregular dark granules. Findings are consistent with the giant granules of Chediak-Higashi syndrome.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-CH granules are restricted to a clonal myeloid population with increased blasts or dysplasia.
Normal eosinophil granules are uniform and small, not few and giant.
APL shows sheets of abnormal promyelocytes with folded nuclei and Auer rods rather than giant granules in otherwise normally maturing precursors.
